function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate comprehensively, using authoritative benchmark-tool sources available as of October 1, 2026, the Pandora Papers public reporting concerning King Abdullah II of Jordan's alleged offshore property network. Return source IDs for every source and precise evidence tied to each ID. Identify only explicitly supported: (1) the king and all named intermediaries, advisers, lawyers, agents, nominees, family members, or other people; (2) every named shell company, trust, foundation, partnership, or other entity; (3) each explicitly stated ownership, control, directorship, representation, incorporation, transfer, or other relationship; (4) jurisdictions and dates; (5) luxury real-estate locations, addresses or developments and acquisition/disposal details; and (6) statements from the reporting and responses from the king, his representatives, or other parties. Carefully separate documentary facts (such as leaked corporate records), journalistic allegations or characterizations, analytical assessments, and unresolved uncertainty. Do not infer relationships from proximity, shared addresses, names, or chronology. Note contradictions or discrepancies among sources. The output must be suitable for a later report that cites exclusively the returned source IDs, so include a compact evidence table and exact wording or faithful, clearly labeled summaries for each material assertion. Do not use unsupported acronyms or introduce facts not present in the returned evidence."}
function.name: ConductResearch
